```python
import threading

def background_thread():
    print("Background thread is running...")
    time.sleep(5)
    print("Background thread has finished.")

# Create a new thread
thread = threading.Thread(target=background_thread)

# Start the thread
thread.start()

# Wait for the thread to complete
thread.join()

print("Main thread has finished.")
```
